narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our journey into the fascinating world of trigonometry! In this lesson, we'll lay the groundwork for understanding how angles and sides of triangles are connected. We'll explore the fundamental concept of trigonometric ratios, which are essential tools in mathematics and many real-world applications. Get ready to discover the power of right-angled triangles!
